Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A brief job-report update notes that unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is an alpine-inspired Swiss eatery offering cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. The site highlights its rustic wooden interiors, city skyline views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. The text is straightforward and makes your contact email easy to find. I think adding a short bio and a few details about your interests or projects would help visitors get to know you and give the site more personality. My feedback is based on the page text I could access, rather than its visual design.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning hiking as your favorite hobby gives the blog a personal focus. I'd love to see more detail—such as stories from recent hikes, favorite trails, or practical tips for fellow hikers—to make it more engaging and useful. My feedback is based on the page text I could access, rather than its visual design.
